title: Hydrothermal engineering of polyethylene glycol-assisted boron nitride/hematite nanohybrid composites for high-performance supercapacitors
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,16035-16049
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA02227D, Paper
Open Access

Shamsiya Shams, B. Bindhu, Adhigan Murali, R. Ramesh, Abdullah Al Souwaileh, Sung Soo Han
PEG-assisted BN/α-Fe2O3 hybrid composites were synthesized via hydrothermal method. PEG enhanced thier thermal and electrochemical propoerties, achieving 361.6 F g−1 capacitance and 85% retention after 5000 cycles, ideal for supercapacitors.
